text:
Sympathetic innervation of the colon originates from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column of the spinal cord at T7–L2. These fibers travel through the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves and synapse in the prevertebral ganglia (celiac, superior and inferior mesenteric). My earlier T10–L2 range falls within this broader gut-wide range, and L3–L5 applies mainly to the hypogastric supply of the distal colon and rectum.

CONFIDENCE: 60
